headline: Congress moves at a crawl—Senate returns Monday to vote on a judicial nominee and tax bill amendment, House stays dark until Tuesday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate was not in session on Friday, November 13. It stands adjourned and will reconvene Monday to handle judicial nominations and legislative business.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Friday for 2 minutes, with Speaker Simpson presiding pro tempore. Four bills (H.R. 11033-11036) were introduced, but no votes were taken. The chamber adjourned at 10:02 a.m.
